decode_path_preflight.why_this_is_published: on LFM2 the manual loop and greedy generate are the same computation; on an mrope model the position ids are computed inside forward in a way tuned for generate, so the equality is an assumption here. emit_zero_floor.definition: finite, non-zero terminal hidden state and non-constant finite logits on every probe.  When a reference terminal-state tensor is supplied the sealer's own form -- relative L2 < 1.0 against it -- is computed as well and BOTH are published.  A parent has no parent, so the relL2 form is null on a calibration run and is not faked.

linear_attention_kernels.note: `kernel_path` is the PER-PRIMITIVE binding read off the loaded model, not the package inventory.  transformers binds the four Gated-DeltaNet primitives independently, so fla's Triton chunked kernel runs even when causal_conv1d is absent and the 'fast path is not available' warning fires -- that warning is printed off is_fast_path_available, which is all() of the four.  `inventory_label_v1_refuted` is what the earlier, wrong rule would have printed, published only so v1 dossiers can be lined up against v2 ones.  Recorded, never enforced.
